STAT 211: Introductory Statistics and Sampling for Accounting
Description: Descriptive statistics, probability, discrete and continuous random variables. Sampling distributions and simple hypothesis testing. Introduction to survey sampling.
Requirements: Prereq: MATH 109; Arts/Acc and SciBiot/CA students only.
